mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate directly increases the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annually) indicates persistent inflation that may lead to prolonged monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls growth exceeds 200,000 per month for three consecutive months, it signals a strong labor market that may lead to wage pressures and central bank hawkishness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation environments (CPIAUCSL <= 4.0%), strong retail sales growth (RSAFS growth > 0.5%) indicates robust consumer spending that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL <= 4.0%.
